envelope.description: Show the issue key, artifact id and revision in the chain report

body.title: Show the issue key, artifact id and revision in the chain report
body.summary: ChainReport.tracker gains read-only artifactId and revision for the Epic's Define (0 when meta.revision is absent) and a stories list with issue, artifactId and revision for each Story head that has an issue; the stored TrackerMeta gains no field. The sync-tracker next action names the explicit refresh instead of the GitHub-only tracker.sync workflow.
acceptanceChecks: the record carries the artifact id and revision for the Epic and each Story with an issue, 0 when absent
the stored TrackerMeta has no new field
the sync-tracker next action names the explicit refresh
